info.title: Tycho-Indexer RPC
info.description: Tycho indexer application binary. Runs the actual indexing. Exposes ws and http endpoints to access extracted data

post.description:
This endpoint retrieves the state of contracts within a specific execution environment. If no
contract ids are given, all contracts are returned. Note that `protocol_system` is not a filter;
it's a way to specify the protocol system associated with the contracts requested and is used to
ensure that the correct extractor's block status is used when querying the database. If omitted,
the block status will be determined by a random extractor, which could be risky if the extractor
is out of sync. Filtering by protocol system is not currently supported on this endpoint and
should be done client side.

get.description: This endpoint is used to check the health of the service.

post.description:
This endpoint retrieves components within a specific execution environment, filtered by various
criteria.
This endpoint retrieves the state of protocols within a specific execution environment.
This endpoint retrieves the protocol systems available in the indexer.

This endpoint retrieves tokens for a specific execution environment, filtered by various
criteria. The tokens are returned in a paginated format.
This endpoint retrieves the traced entry points available in the indexer

AccountOverrides.description:
State overrides for an account.

Used to modify account state. Commonly used for testing contract interactions with specific
state conditions or simulating transactions with modified balances/code.

protocol_system.description:
Filters protocol components by protocol system
Useful when `component_ids` is omitted to fetch all components under a specific system.

signature.description: The signature of the function to trace.

target.description: The address of the contract to trace.

page_size.description: How many results to return per page

total.description: The total number of items available across all pages of results

ProtocolComponent.description: Represents the static parts of a protocol component.

contract_ids.description:
Contract addresses involved in the components operations (may be empty for
native implementations)

created_at.description: Date time of creation in UTC time

creation_tx.description: Transaction hash which created this component

protocol_system.description: Protocol system this component is part of

tokens.description: Token addresses the component operates on

ProtocolComponentRequestResponse.description: Response from Tycho server for a protocol components request.

protocol_system.description:
Filters by protocol, required to correctly apply unconfirmed state from
ReorgBuffers

tvl_gt.description:
The minimum TVL of the protocol components to return, denoted in the chain's
native token.

ProtocolStateDelta.description: Represents a change in protocol state.

include_balances.description: Whether to include account balances in the response. Defaults to true.

protocol_ids.description: Filters response by protocol components ids

protocol_system.description:
Filters by protocol, required to correctly apply unconfirmed state from
ReorgBuffers

dci_protocols.description:
Protocol systems that use Dynamic Contract Indexing (DCI).
Clients should only fetch entrypoints for these protocols.

protocol_systems.description: List of currently supported protocol systems

calldata.description: The call data used for the tracing call, this needs to include the function selector

caller.description:
The caller address of the transaction, if not provided tracing uses the default value
for an address defined by the VM.

prune_addresses.description:
Addresses to prune from trace results. Useful for hooks that use mock
accounts/routers that shouldn't be tracked in the final DCI results.

state_overrides.description: Optionally allow for state overrides so that the call works as expected

ResponseAccount.description:
Account struct for the response from Tycho server for a contract state request.

Code is serialized as a hex string instead of a list of bytes.

address.description: The address of the account as hex encoded string

balance_modify_tx.description: Transaction hash which last modified native balance

code.description: The accounts code as hex encoded string

code_modify_tx.description: Transaction hash which last modified code

creation_tx.description: Transaction hash which created the account

native_balance.description: The balance of the account in the native token

slots.description: Contract storage map of hex encoded string values

title.description: The title of the account usualy specifying its function within the protocol

token_balances.description:
Balances of this account in other tokens (only tokens balance that are
relevant to the protocol are returned here)

ResponseProtocolState.description: Protocol State struct for the response from Tycho server for a protocol state request.

attributes.description:
Attributes of the component. If an attribute's value is a `bigint`,
it will be encoded as a big endian signed hex string.

balances.description: Sum aggregated balances of the component

component_id.description: Component id this state belongs to

ResponseToken.description: Token struct for the response from Tycho server for a tokens request.

address.description: The address of this token as hex encoded string

decimals.description: The number of decimals used to represent token values

gas.description: Gas usage of the token, currently is always a single averaged value

quality.description:
Quality is between 0-100, where:
- 100: Normal ERC-20 Token behavior
- 75: Rebasing token
- 50: Fee-on-transfer token
- 10: Token analysis failed at first detection
- 5: Token analysis failed multiple times (after creation)
- 0: Failed to extract attributes, like Decimal or Symbol

symbol.description: A shorthand symbol for this token (not unique)

tax.description: The tax this token charges on transfers in basis points

protocol_system.description:
Does not filter response, only required to correctly apply unconfirmed state
from ReorgBuffers

StateRequestResponse.description: Response from Tycho server for a contract state request.

Diff.description:
Applies changes incrementally to the existing account storage.
Only modifies the specific storage slots provided in the map while
preserving all other storage slots.

Replace.description:
Completely replaces the account's storage state.
Only the storage slots provided in the map will exist after the operation,
and any existing storage slots not included will be cleared/zeroed.

min_quality.description:
Quality is between 0-100, where:
- 100: Normal ERC-20 Token behavior
- 75: Rebasing token
- 50: Fee-on-transfer token
- 10: Token analysis failed at first detection
- 5: Token analysis failed multiple times (after creation)
- 0: Failed to extract attributes, like Decimal or Symbol

traded_n_days_ago.description: Filters tokens by recent trade activity

TokensRequestResponse.description: Response from Tycho server for a tokens request.

protocol_system.description:
Filters by protocol, required to correctly apply unconfirmed state from
ReorgBuffers

traced_entry_points.description:
Map of protocol component id to a list of a tuple containing each entry point with its
tracing parameters and its corresponding tracing results.

VersionParam.description:
The version of the requested state, given as either a timestamp or a block.

If block is provided, the state at that exact block is returned. Will error if the block
has not been processed yet. If timestamp is provided, the state at the latest block before
that timestamp is returned.
Defaults to the current time.
